timing_basis: No scheduled or agreed deadlines; dates require a future authorized engagement.

milestones.proposed_request: Reconcile phase identity, ownership, permits, delivery milestones, utility/customer commitments and cancellation obligations.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Dated phase register and appropriately scoped contract or assurance evidence; unresolved phase matches retained.
milestones.financial_use: Replace commissioning, utilization, power price and capital-recovery assumptions.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Infrastructure investment, utility contracting and project delivery; actual owner unconfirmed

milestones.theme: Hardware economic life and capital recovery
milestones.proposed_request: Separate cohort economic service, replacement spending, redeployment/resale, book life and actual tax entitlement.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Dated cohort reconciliation and documented replacement/resale assumptions with shorter-life sensitivity.
milestones.financial_use: Recalculate replacement cash flows, cash taxes and residual value.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Infrastructure finance, engineering and tax; actual owner unconfirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Explain site-specific power architecture, delivery dependencies, backup service, fuel, ownership and exit obligations.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Scoped engineering and contractual evidence identifying who pays each capital, operating and reliability cost.
milestones.financial_use: Compare deliverable grid and dedicated-generation alternatives without hidden backup or resale credits.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Energy procurement, engineering and finance; actual owner unconfirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Reconcile phase-level water source, withdrawals/consumption, seasonal restrictions, land disturbance and measured mitigation.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Defined boundary, baseline, period and appropriately scoped measurement and permission evidence.
milestones.financial_use: Change costs or operating availability only through an evidenced causal mechanism.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Environmental management and site operations; actual owner unconfirmed

milestones.proposed_request: Provide non-sensitive assurance on operational responsibility, recovery objectives, service credits and liability allocation.
milestones.evidence_criterion: Aggregate tested-recovery evidence with coverage and limits; no confidential security detail requested for public release.
milestones.financial_use: Replace conditional outage severity and recoverability; estimate frequency only with separate calibrated evidence.
milestones.proposed_responsible_function: Operational technology, security, operations and commercial contracting; actual owner unconfirmed
